title: Bellig Tower Base
subtitle: Revenant and the Hammer of Lightning at the top of the tower
steps: In the Facility Hub, ask the Warden about Bellig Tower (level 40+).
Take the Bellig Tower Base portal. Expect attackers on arrival.
Climb to the library at the top.
Kill the Revenant and take the Hammer of Lightning.
Show it to the Warden for the reward.

notes.title: Item source
notes.body: The data does not place the Hammer of Lightning. The Warden text says the Revenant has it, so it drops from him (inferred).

notes.title: Best damage
notes.body: The Revenant takes cold at 0.1 and pierce at 0.52. Granite Golems on the way also take cold at 0.1 and fire at 0.4.

notes.title: Top portal
notes.body: The Bellig Top portal, at the very top of the base (114 m up), leads into the upper tower.
